display.summary: After Apply, the Operations panel shows the result; clearer stack-schema warning; PDF viewer zoom and fullscreen fixed.
highlights: After Apply repairs the panel shows the repaired deployment instead of the old proposal, and the same diff cannot be applied twice.
The stack-schema warning names recreating web and celery when compose.yml is already current.
PDF viewer: zoom works in the record modal, fullscreen toggles back, pages read correctly in Arabic.
Includes 1.13.0b2–b4: the Operations panel. Includes 1.13.0b1: the maintenance page moves into the Composer image (stack schema 3).
